messages:
alyssa: Heads up — after the RBAC rename earlier today a bunch of users report SSO failures to app-prod. Okta shows 200 on the SAML response but our ACS logs an assertion validation error. Anyone?

security-oncall-bot: :rotating_light: Incident created INC-2026 by alyssa — SSO failures in app-prod. Pager duty notified.

ben: Looking. Which ACS URL is IdP sending? we changed LB hostnames last week.

alyssa: Okta assertion includes ACS `https://app.redwood-inference.com/sso/saml/acs` but our SP metadata (deployed) still lists `https://app-prod.redwood-inference.com/sso/saml/acs`. We also renamed the sso service account in the RBAC PR this morning.

sam: That explains a mismatch — SP metadata + ACS must match exactly. Also saw a related cookie domain config change in the last deploy. If cookie domain is set to `.app.redwood-inference.com` but users landing on `app-prod` host, browser may drop session cookie.

jordan: Audit trail shows the SAML assertion was signed and accepted by the proxy but we never create a session. Splunk extract: `saml.validation: failed reason="cookie_domain_mismatch" expected=.redwood-inference.com got=app-prod.redwood-inference.com`

lisa: Confirming recent deploy at 09:02 changed env `COOKIE_DOMAIN=.app.redwood-inference.com` per deploy bot message.

deploy-bot: Deploy #2026 finished: service=sso env=prod changes=[RBAC: rename sso-deploy->sso-deployer, COOKIE_DOMAIN=.app.redwood-inference.com]

alyssa: Also seeing SCIM oddities for new hires — SCIM returns 409 duplicates and KMS logs show decrypt failures for the old principal: `ERROR kms-client: Decrypt failed: InvalidCiphertextException: CiphertextBlob malformed`

sam: RBAC rename likely removed decrypt permission on kms alias `alias/sso-key` for the new principal. Combined with incorrect SP metadata/cookie domain — sessions fail and SCIM attempts fallback flows that cause duplicates.

ben: Quick triage plan: 1) revert COOKIE_DOMAIN to `.redwood-inference.com` in prod (hotfix), 2) update SP metadata in Okta to match current ACS, 3) verify KMS alias permissions for new principal, 4) run SCIM backfill for duplicates if needed.

jordan: Agree. From security side we need to record mitigation steps in the incident doc and capture audit logs for all deprovision/provision events. If we backfill SCIM we must keep an immutable log entry for changes.

alyssa: Rolling cookie change now (temp rollback). Command: `kubectl set env deploy/sso COOKIE_DOMAIN=.redwood-inference.com -n prod && kubectl rollout restart deploy/sso -n prod`

lisa: Patch applied and restarted. Confirmed cookie header now `Set-Cookie: session=...; Domain=.redwood-inference.com; Path=/; Secure; HttpOnly; SameSite=None` in responses.

ben: Okta metadata updated with new ACS and audience URL. I pushed new SP XML via Okta UI and saved.

sam: Pushed a KMS policy fix to grant `kms:Decrypt` on alias/sso-key to `arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/sso-deployer` (new principal). Logs show decrypt success after change: `INFO kms-client: decrypt OK for request sso-service-account`

alyssa: Running SCIM reconcile for affected users now. Command: `python tools/scim_reconcile.py --env prod --dry-run=false --since 2026-03-21T08:00Z`

tas: Verified login flow from EU and NA — users can SSO again. :thumbsup: We should monitor for 15m and then mark incident resolved.

jordan: Captured mitigation steps and timeline in INC-2026. Please add any follow-ups: RBAC deploy checklist (ensure KMS policies get updated), SP metadata validation step in deploy pipeline, and post-deploy smoke-test for SSO.

ben: I'll open a follow-up PR to add an automated check that SP metadata in Okta matches `SAML_ACS_URL` env in prod prior to promoting deploy.

security-oncall-bot: Incident INC-2026 status: mitigated -> monitoring by alyssa, ben.

alyssa: Thanks all. Will keep monitoring logs for audit entries: `session:create`, `scim:provision`, `kms:decrypt` and will post if we see regressions.

deploy-bot: Note: rollback of COOKIE_DOMAIN env was a one-line hotfix; please include migration notes in PR #2345.

sam: Follow-ups set: (1) RBAC runbook update, (2) KMS key alias rotation plan, (3) add SSO smoke test in release pipeline.

tas: Works for me. Closing loop once 30m stable. :eyes:
